label: FIU: Computer Science (B.S.)
source: 2026-2027 MDC Transfer Guide: FIU Computer Science (B.S.)

requirements.note: The guide lists the first four and says any other State Core natural science course + lab also works. The last four pairs are our reading of that rule: confirm with FIU. ESC 1000 has no lab at MDC (complete the lab after transfer).
The guide also allows any other Group 2 course + lab; only the three named pairs are listed here.

notes: FIU requires the completed AA degree, a 2.0 or higher cumulative transfer GPA, and a C or higher in every prerequisite.
MAC 2311 must be completed before transfer.
Prerequisites need a C or higher within two attempts; drops and withdrawals (W) count as attempts.
At least 8 credits of science courses, including labs, are required in this degree.
COP 2805C transfers as an upper-division course.
FIU encourages finishing these courses before completing the AA, and taking math and science every term.
